summary: Per-call state machine: when the session state guard DWORD at obj+0x3FC4 is non-zero, dispatches input commands to entities and synchronizes the session using a scoring default-return float; then unconditionally clears the flag byte at obj+0x374 to 0. Returns the guard value when zero, otherwise the object pointer.

operations.description: Load the object pointer from this+0.
Read the state guard DWORD at obj+0x3FC4 (v2[4081]) into the result value.
If the guard is zero, skip input dispatch and session sync but still clear the +0x374 flag below.
Dispatch input commands to entities via InputCommandDispatchToEntities.
Load the default scoring return float from dbl_8AFE98 into the SessionSynchronizer argument.
Synchronize session state via SessionSynchronizer using the object pointer and the scoring default return float.
Set the result to the object pointer after a successful sync.
Unconditionally clear the flag byte at obj+0x374 to 0.
Return the guard value on the zero path or the object pointer on the sync path.

unresolved: Object type, the meaning of the +0x374 flag and +0x3FC4 guard, and the exact semantics of the SessionSynchronizer float argument are unresolved.
